Sylas

the Unshackled
Mid laneJungle laneTop laneSupport lane

Jungle Sylas is one of the strongest junglers this patch. Petricite Burst clears camps quickly, Kingslayer keeps you healthy, and Abscond / Abduct gives you a long-range gank. Your stolen ultimates make your ganks and objective fights even scarier, especially with lanes that already have strong crowd control.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Sylas

✓ Safe blind pick

Fairly safe. He's one of the strongest junglers this patch, but early duelists like Briar can punish him.

Pick into

  • Enemy teams with big ultimates to steal for objective fights
  • Farming junglers who can't punish his early clears, like Shyvana
  • Diving junglers whose engage you can interrupt with Abduct, like Hecarim
  • Lanes on your team with crowd control to follow up on ganks

Avoid into

  • Kiting junglers like Lillia who out-run him
  • Strong early duelists like Briar who invade before his first item
  • Very tanky engage junglers like Zac

Great teammates

GangplankGangplank's barrels and global ultimate combo with Sylas's skirmishing.
SettA strong top laner who follows Sylas's ganks and frontlines fights.
KatarinaHer resets clean up after Sylas starts fights with a stolen ultimate.

Your team needs: Pick jungle Sylas when your lanes have crowd control for ganks and a frontline for objective fights.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Fast, healthy clears thanks to Petricite Burst area damage and Kingslayer healing
  • Abduct (E2) is a long-range gank tool that knocks up the target
  • You see every enemy ultimate across the map and can steal the best one for teamfights
  • Strong skirmisher around Void Grubs, Herald and dragons

Weaknesses

  • Weak to early invades by strong duelists before you have your first item
  • If Abduct misses, ganks often fail
  • Point-and-click crowd control stops your dives
  • Relies on Hextech Rocketbelt to really take over

Power spikes

  • Level 3: full clear done; first gank or scuttle fight at 2:55
  • Level 6: Hijack lets you gank with your target's ultimate
  • First item (Hextech Rocketbelt): an extra dash for ganks and burst
  • Two items (Riftmaker): you become a frontline brawler in objective fights
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): dive the backline in teamfights

Top tips

  • Weave an auto between every spell to clear faster
  • Gank lanes that have crowd control: your combo follows up perfectly
  • Save Kingslayer for when you're low; it heals more
  • Steal a teamfight ultimate before every big objective fight
  • Keep Smite for the objective, not for clearing
  • Track the enemy jungler and avoid early duels before Rocketbelt
  • Complete your jungle quest early for Primal Smite and extra movement speed
